preconditions.description: Number of nodes and queries are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 1000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Initial values of nodes are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n and 1 <= u_i <= n for v_i, u_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Edge indices are within the specified range.
The number of edges is exactly n-1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(query[0] in ['1', '2'] for query in queries)
preconditions.description: Queries are either type '1' or type '2'.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(query[1]) <= n for query in queries)
preconditions.description: Node indices in queries are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(query[2]) <= 1000 for query in queries if query[0] == '1')
preconditions.description: Values added in type '1' queries are within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == str(current_values[int(queries[i][1])]) for i in range(m) if queries[i][0] == '2')
postconditions.description: For each type '2' query, the output is the current value of the specified node.
